question: In August 2025, DRDO's Defence Metallurgical Research Laboratory (DMRL) transferred the technology for manufacturing high-strength radomes to which of the following companies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **August 2025**, the **Defence Metallurgical Research Laboratory (DMRL)**, a premier laboratory of the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**, transferred the manufacturing technology for **high-strength radomes** to **Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL)**.
 
• This **Technology Transfer (ToT)** is aimed at indigenizing the production of critical components used in **aerospace and defense** applications. ***Hence, the correct answer is Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL).***
 
• The technology involves the fabrication of advanced ceramic-based **radomes** that can withstand extreme **aerodynamic heating** and mechanical stresses encountered during high-speed flights of missiles and aircraft.
